posts.text:
Senate Republicans are once again wasting time on voter suppression with an amendment to the SAVE Act that would impose the single strictest voter-ID law in America.

This amendment would undo the sacred secrecy of our ballots. 

Democrats won't let it happen.

99% of the SAVE Act isn't about voter ID, but about kicking 20 million American citizens off the voter rolls and making re-registering a bureaucratic nightmare.

Trump and Republicans only want people who agree with them to be able to vote.

Not on our watch.

Trump promised lower energy bills. Instead, they skyrocketed.

Democrats’ plan to bring them down:
1. Build more clean energy
2. Cut delays — not protections
3. Fix the grid
4. Make data centers pay their fair share
5. Protect consumers

nytimes.com/2026/03/25/clima…

Donald Trump is lifting sanctions on Iran, giving them $14 billion in the process, all to try to solve an energy prices problem that was created by his reckless war in the first place. 

@SenateGOP used to sound the alarm about this type of action. 

Now? Silence.

Video

2.5 million people kicked off SNAP in less than a year. The most vulnerable among us.
 
All while Trump skyrockets prices across the board with his aimless war.
 
Everything @POTUS does is America and Americans last.


Katie Bergh (@Katie_Bergh)

New USDA data show 2.5 million fewer people participated in SNAP in December compared to July, when the Republican megabill (H.R. 1) enacted the deepest SNAP cuts in history. This is only the beginning — even more people will lose SNAP as the full brunt

Donald Trump can’t get enough of losing to @TishJames. 

This time will be no different than the last two.


Kaitlan Collins (@kaitlancollins)

President Trump’s top housing official Bill Pulte issued two new criminal referrals for New York Attorney General Letitia James on Wednesday, attempting to revive the administration’s ongoing legal pursuit of one of his political opponents. 
cnn.com/2026/03/25/politics/…

Americans are already skipping meals thanks to Trump’s reckless war of choice in Iran, and this is just another example of how his chaos is making it harder to afford food.

As Trump’s heartless SNAP cuts go into effect over the next year, the lowest income families will only struggle more to feed their kids as prices rise.

If Republicans want to shove the SAVE Act into reconciliation, then have at it.
 
Democrats will fight it tooth and nail, every step of the way. They're going to find it very difficult to jam these massive changes to the American election system.

Today, for the TENTH TIME, Democrats will go to the floor to demand that we pay TSA immediately. 
 
And for the TENTH TIME, Republicans will have a chance to join us. I’m not holding my breath.

9 times. That’s how many times the @SenateGOP has BLOCKED our attempts to fully fund TSA.


Tom Cotton (@TomCottonAR)

Chuck Schumer should apologize to the millions of Americans forced to wait for hours at airports. 

Schumer is directly responsible. 

He cares more about helping criminal illegal aliens and appeasing the far-left than he cares about national security.



— https://nitter.net/TomCottonAR/status/2036818892815831121#m

Senate Republicans have now blocked TSA funding 9 times.
 
They are solely responsible for the chaos travelers are experiencing.
 
We welcome them to join Democrats at the table any time to fund TSA and restore order to our airports.

Video

According to Trump, vote-by-mail is cheating when a busy mom of three kids with two jobs uses it, but perfectly fine when he uses it himself.

His polling location is less than a 15-minute drive from Mar-a-Lago.

His decision to vote by mail shows just how hypocritical his lies about fraud and cheating truly are.
washingtonpost.com/politics/…

ICE needs to leave the airports NOW.

Trump needs to pay TSA workers NOW, and push Republicans to reach a deal.

No intimidation forces at our airports. No more chaos at checkpoints.

Enough is enough.

The MAGA Voter ID provision is a cover up to the SAVE Act’s core voter suppression provisions.
 
Let’s be clear: this bill and this provision are about purging millions of Americans from the voter rolls to tip the scales for a flailing Donald Trump.

Video

He’s unhinged, confused, and in completely over his head. No plan, no strategy. This is embarrassing.


Aaron Rupar (@atrupar)

COLLINS: The Treasury lifted sanctions on Iranian oil. You criticized President Obama for giving Iran $1.7b----

TRUMP: Well I just want to have as much oil in the system as possible. We don't even know that Iran gets that money. Any small amount of money Iran gets is not gonna make a difference in this war

COLLINS: Even $14b you don't think helps them?

TRUMP: Where's

This is bone chilling.

The disease of undermining elections is rampant in the right wing of the Republican party, and it seems they will use any means they can to achieve that goal.

This is how authoritarians turn law enforcement into intimidation forces, and this is why Democrats won’t stop until we rein in ICE.

Trump threw a temper tantrum yesterday and demanded Republicans’ voter suppression bill be part of any deal to pay TSA workers. This was an outrageous demand from the start, and it wasted a day of negotiations.

Democrats knew it.
Republicans knew it.

A day may not seem like a lot to Trump, but that’s another day of TSA workers waiting for checks, another day of travelers standing for hours at a time at security, and another day of chaos at our airports.

A month ago, the national price of gasoline as $2.93 a gallon.
 
Today it's $3.94. 
 
One man is to blame: Donald Trump.

ICE must change its violent ways. The last thing Americans want is ICE detaining passengers at airports and making things worse. 
 
Sometimes the simplest solution is the best: Fund TSA, rein in ICE, and move our country in the right direction.
